# AnvayKosh (अन्वयकोश) — Sovereign Personal Technology Ecosystem

> An authoritative multi-system sovereign technology fabric engineered by Amit Chakraborty (Amit Dev Labs). Unifies five production client applications, extended commerce and fleet logistics suites (Ravuno, Haulwise), hardware keystore enclaves, and non-destructive nullish coalescing under Strict Law 6 with zero advertising telemetry.

## Flagship Client Applications
- Thrivefold (com.amit.thrivefold, thrivefold://): Mindful fitness, joint biomechanics & on-device pose tracking via MediaPipe with 0 bytes transmitted to cloud.
- Neev (com.amit.neev, neev://): Private family operating system, sacred spaces, and zero-telemetry emergency radar maps with offline vector MBTiles.
- HarmonyBloom (com.amit.harmonybloom, harmonybloom://): Mindful hormonal harmony, circadian cycle dial, and cryptographic health isolation.
- BlinkQuest (com.amit.blinkquest, blinkquest://): Vision ergonomics and on-device 30fps Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) blink rate tracking.
- Setu (com.amit.setu, setu://): Sovereign offline P2P Wi-Fi Direct swarm mesh (120+ Mbps) and flagship Anvay ID hardware Keystore identity anchor.

## Extended Production Products
- Ravuno: Decentralized offline-first commerce and micro-merchant ledger enabling local P2P payments and inventory tracking with cryptographic ed25519 invoice proofs.
- Haulwise: Autonomous offline fleet logistics and turn-by-turn dead-reckoning navigation using local vector tiles with zero third-party broker tracking.
- Amit Intelligence Admin: Mission control administrative portal built with Next.js 16 and React 19 for monitoring AI pipelines and task queues.
- Aura Mobile Starter: Enterprise-grade mobile architecture foundation using Expo 55, React Native, and Skia.
- Telehealth Core Engine: HIPAA-compliant clinical consultation routing and encrypted scheduling service.

## Core Platform Subsystems
- Anvay ID: Federated 1-tap single sign-on using OAuth 2.1 authorization code with PKCE (RFC 7636/9700). URLs carry short-lived one-time codes only.
- Anvay Vault: Shared personal repository implementing Strict Law 6 (non-destructive nullish coalescing: incoming records populate empty fields without overwriting existing data).
- Anvay Connect: Inter-app protocol bound by Android 11+ `<queries>` and signature-level permissions on ContentProviders.
- Anvay Sync & Local RAG: Offline-first hybrid search over local SQLite databases using FTS5 and LiteRT embeddings.

## Seven Sovereign Architectural Laws
1. Zero Deep-Link Lock Bypass: Device biometric lock must always be verified first.
2. Standard OAuth 2.1 PKCE Only: Query strings carry short-lived codes only, never PII.
3. Server-Enforced Cryptographic Registry: Unknown apps fail closed.
4. Decentralized Sovereign Autonomy: Every app functions completely standalone and offline.
5. Granular Category-Level Consent: Signing in grants zero data; apps request categories explicitly.
6. Non-Destructive Nullish Coalescing: Provenance and user data are never blindly overwritten.
7. Zero Secret Exposure & Local Processing: Biometrics and camera frames remain in volatile RAM only.
